_meta.purpose: Every Uber Move face the kit declares with @font-face. scripts/build-tokens.mjs fails if a Figma text style names a family and weight that is not listed here.
_meta.files: public/fonts/, copied to dist/fonts/ by Vite. The directory is gitignored: the fonts are licensed exclusively to Uber, so they stay out of the repository like the other client material.
source: Uber Move and Uber Move Text: official UberMove_English package, webfonts/*.woff2, Version 1.003, received 2026-09-28.
Uber Move Mono: official UberMove_Monospace package, webfonts/*.woff2, Version 1.003, received 2026-09-28. It replaced the 1.001 desktop copies; 1.003 adds two glyphs (U+25A0, U+25CF) and drops none.
Each woff2 has the same character set as the OTF and TTF in its package. The 1.003 OTFs are what is installed on the design machine.
_meta.licence: Name table ID 13 on every file: 'This custom font has been licensed exclusively to Uber.' Confirm web-embedding rights before deploying these files anywhere public.
_meta.weights: Uber Move Mono files report usWeightClass 432 and 568. They are declared at 400 and 500, the weights the Figma text styles were pinned to on 2026-09-14.
_meta.local: The PostScript name only, and only as a fallback after the file. On 2026-09-28 a local() lookup by full name ("Uber Move Mono Medium") resolved to stale cached font data right after the installed copy was replaced, and rendered Mono Medium as garbage. The PostScript-name lookup and the woff2 file were both correct.
